questions.stem: Why is fibre important in the diet even though it provides no energy?

options.text: It is broken down to produce amino acids
It helps muscles contract more efficiently
It provides vitamins that the body needs
It adds bulk to food and helps move it through the digestive system

questions.explanation: Fibre cannot be digested but adds bulk to food, which stimulates peristalsis and helps move food through the intestines, preventing constipation.
